events.title: Snowed In is at Steam Next Fest! ❄️
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is here! 🎉The Snowed In free demo is available to play now!Dig through massive amounts of snow, discover hidden places, find new tools, and uncover what lies beneath the avalanche. ❄️If you enjoy the demo, please consider adding Snowed In to your wishlist — it really helps the game! ❤️Steam Next Fest — October 19–26 Play the free demo now!

events.title: 5,000 Players! Thank You! ❄️
events.summary: Snowed In has reached 5,000 players! 🎉Thank you so much to everyone who has played the demo, shared the game, made videos, or added Snowed In to their wishlist. Your support means a lot to me! ❤️And this is just the beginning... ❄️Snowed In is participating in Steam Next Fest — October 19–26! Play the free demo and add the game to your wishlist!

events.title: Snowed In Demo — Major Update 0.1.5
events.summary: ❄️ Snowed In Demo — Major UpdateHi everyone!Over the past few weeks, I've been working on a major round of improvements for the Snowed In Demo, based on player feedback, videos, bug reports, and a lot of additional testing.This update focuses on polishing the core experience, improving performance and controls, fixing frustrating bugs, expanding support for different displays and controllers, and adding some new things to discover.And yes... I've also hidden a few new secrets around the house. 👀

events.title: 🎉 3,000 Players! ❄️
events.summary: 🎉 3,000 Players! ❄️More than 3,000 players have already played the Snowed In Demo!Thank you so much to everyone who has played, shared feedback, reported bugs, or simply added the game to their wishlist. ❤️I'm currently working on fixes, improvements, new secrets, and a few surprises before Steam Next Fest.Thank you for being part of Snowed In! ☃️See you in the snow! ❄️

events.title: 1,000+ Players! Thank You! ❄️
events.summary: Snowed In has just passed 1,000 demo downloads! 🎉Thank you so much to everyone who has checked out the demo, shared videos, left feedback, and added Snowed In to their wishlist.Seeing so many people digging through the snow and discovering the game has been amazing!This is only the beginning — there’s still a lot more buried beneath the snow. 👀❄️Thank you for being part of Snowed In! ❤️

events.title: Snowed In Demo Runs Great on Steam Deck! ❄️🎮
events.summary: We’re happy to share that the current Snowed In Demo has been tested from start to finish on a real Steam Deck!The entire demo can be played using the Steam Deck’s built-in controls, including gameplay, menus, interactions, and all core gameplay features.We’ve also added full controller support for Xbox and DualSense controllers, with appropriate button prompts in-game.We’ll continue making sure Snowed In provides a great experience on Steam Deck as development continues.See you under the snow!
